processing.defringe: For neutral near-white RGB edge pixels with alpha below 96, replace RGB with the mean nearest non-neutral core color within Chebyshev radius 1 then 2; preserve alpha.
processing.remove_components: Remove connected components under 1024 pixels only when they touch a 12-pixel frame boundary. This removed one 229-pixel clipped scaffold fragment from foundation frame 0.
processing.normalize: Keep source resolution; center each alpha silhouette horizontally and align its bottom to y=700 in the 543x724 cell.

render.fallback: Existing V18 SVG house and V26 structure-state path remain available on load failure.
